description:
Hey! I'm putting together a team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge this weekend (Nov 14-15) and I'm looking for 3-4 coders to build with.

I'll take care of the design, documentation, and pitch. It's fully virtual, so you can be anywhere in the world.

looking for:
• Intermediate level or above in Python, JavaScript, or similar
• Some experience with APIs or working with data
